annotations.title: Validate an EVM address and return its EIP-55 checksum form

description: Validate an EVM address and return its EIP-55 checksum form. Checks the 0x + 40 hex format, verifies a mixed-case EIP-55 checksum (flags typos), and returns the checksummed and lowercase forms and whether it is the zero address. No network access. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
